scenicChapters.title: Teide National Park Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 54 km this is Teide National Park Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

story: From La Guancha it runs 323 km to La Guancha; allow about 5 h 34 of riding. On the way it passes San Cristóbal de La Laguna, Risco Caido and the Sacred Mountains of Gr and back through San Cristóbal de La Laguna. The highest point is about 1,150 m. Expect gradients and long views.
